title: A d20 template rolled loose, as a character's attack die, and as a goblin's die
description: One d20 template in the GM binder, spawned three ways. The GM's loose die has modifier empty, so total equals value. Aldric's die is spawned with owner Aldric and modifier as the formula owner.attack_bonus, so total follows Aldric's bonus without a reroll. The goblin's die is spawned owned by the goblin (a character, DESIGN §4.4) with the same modifier formula, so it picks up the goblin's bonus. The rolls (14, 11, 9) and bonuses (Aldric 5 then 6, goblin 4) are chosen by this transcription.

objects.note: A character so that it can own a die: owner points at a character (DESIGN §4.4).
The fixture's template verbatim, plus owner: empty, which the loose die depends on.

steps.note: The GM drags a loose die out of the binder onto the table: no initial cells.

expect.note: FORMULAS §8.3: `spawn` "Copy the template subgraph ... set the given cells, set `template`, place at the destination."
FORMULAS §8.3: `spawn` "Copy the template subgraph ... set the given cells, set `template`, place at the destination."
"A GM's loose die has `modifier` empty, so `total` equals `value`." A loose die is spawned with no owner; the template's owner is empty.
"A GM's loose die has `modifier` empty, so `total` equals `value`."
"total = value + modifier" with both empty; FORMULAS §2.1: "`empty` in arithmetic is `0`" ("`total` is `0` before the roll", FIXTURES §9).
FORMULAS §8.3: `spawn` "Copy the template subgraph ... set the given cells, set `template`, place at the destination." A copy is made; the template stays in the binder.

steps.note: The GM rolls the loose die (scripted 14).

expect.note: "[Roll]  roll(1d20) -> value"; FIXTURES §5: "Each `roll(...)` step that runs takes the next entry ... The roll result is written as given."
"A GM's loose die has `modifier` empty, so `total` equals `value`." FORMULAS §2.2: a roll result "acts as a number (its total) in arithmetic and comparison"; 14 + empty = 14.

"the `log_includes` roll effect asserts it was recorded" (FIXTURES §9). FORMULAS §8.1: logged with "the resolved values (the dice rolled, the id spawned)"; FIXTURES §7: "A `roll` matches a roll the group recorded and the cell it was written to."

steps.note: Aldric's attack die: the same template, owner set at spawn, modifier a formula.

expect.note: "A character's attack die is this template with `modifier = owner.attack_bonus` as a formula and `owner` set at spawn."

"A character's attack die is this template with `modifier = owner.attack_bonus` as a formula and `owner` set at spawn." FORMULAS §3: "Dot-access follows a reference: `target.ac`, `owner.attack_bonus`"; Aldric's attack_bonus is 5.
"total = value + modifier": empty + 5 = 5 before the roll; FORMULAS §2.1: "`empty` in arithmetic is `0`".
"[Roll]  roll(1d20) -> value"; FIXTURES §5: "Each `roll(...)` step that runs takes the next entry ... The roll result is written as given."
"total = value + modifier": 11 + 5 = 16; FORMULAS §2.2: a roll result "acts as a number (its total) in arithmetic and comparison".
FORMULAS §8.3: `spawn` "Copy the template subgraph ... set the given cells, set `template`, place at the destination." Each copy has its own cells, so the loose die keeps its 14.
FORMULAS §8.1: logged with "the resolved values (the dice rolled, the id spawned)"; FIXTURES §7: "A `roll` matches a roll the group recorded and the cell it was written to."
"`modifier = owner.attack_bonus` as a formula"; DESIGN §4.2: "Formulas are reactive. Change an input and dependents recompute."
"A later `set` of Aldric's `attack_bonus` moves `total` without a reroll" (FIXTURES §9): 11 + 6 = 17.
FORMULAS §8: "Actions are the only place anything is written or rolled"; no action ran, so the roll result stands.
FIXTURES §8: "An `invoke` is one group for the whole action; `set`, `override`, `clear_override`, `move`, and `spawn` are one group each": spawn, invoke, spawn, invoke, set.
FIXTURES §8: "`log_includes.group` indexes groups from the start, 0-based"; group 3 is Aldric's Roll and still records the 11.

steps.note: The goblin's die: the same template owned by the goblin, with the same modifier formula.

expect.note: "A goblin's die is owned by the goblin."
"A goblin's die is owned by the goblin." With the character-die formula owner.attack_bonus (a transcription choice), the modifier is the goblin's 4.
"total = value + modifier": empty + 4 = 4; FORMULAS §2.1: "`empty` in arithmetic is `0`".

steps.note: The GM rolls for the goblin (scripted 9).

expect.note: "[Roll]  roll(1d20) -> value"; FIXTURES §5: "Each `roll(...)` step that runs takes the next entry ... The roll result is written as given."
"total = value + modifier": 9 + 4 = 13; FORMULAS §2.2: a roll result "acts as a number (its total) in arithmetic and comparison".
"modifier = owner.attack_bonus": aldric_die's owner is Aldric (6), so 11 + 6 is unchanged by the goblin's die.
FORMULAS §8.1: logged with "the resolved values (the dice rolled, the id spawned)"; FIXTURES §7: "A `roll` matches a roll the group recorded and the cell it was written to."
FIXTURES §8: "An `invoke` is one group for the whole action; `set`, `override`, `clear_override`, `move`, and `spawn` are one group each": three spawns, three invokes, one set.
